baseline: H0: existing 60-observation residual momentum centered rank with EWMA(0.25)
B00: prior-only 250-observation new-high Long / new-low Short breakout with EWMA(0.25)

walk_forward_folds.role: development evaluation; first full 250-observation fit history
January-March partial/previously seen Train; descriptive only

trials.description: Ridge lambda=1.0 on the three fixed slope, channel-position and volume-zscore features
Fixed shallow LightGBM on the same three features and target

feature_definitions.log_price_slope_60_bps_day: OLS slope of log(split-safe raw Close) over the 60 observations t-60 through t-1, times 10000; no signal-date t prices.
feature_definitions.channel_position_250: 2*(Close(t-1)-min(Low(t-251:t-2)))/(max(High(t-251:t-2))-min(Low(t-251:t-2)))-1. Prior 250 valid observations exclude t-1; High maps to +1, Low to -1, and out-of-range values are not clipped.
feature_definitions.volume_zscore_60: (Volume(t-1)-mean(Volume(t-61:t-2)))/population_std(Volume(t-61:t-2)), using 60 strictly earlier split-safe raw Volume observations; zero standard deviation is missing.
feature_definitions.corporate_actions: Raw OHLCV only. AdjustmentFactor event multipliers are cumulated causally within listing segments to express prices and volume in a common share unit.
feature_definitions.missing_values: Feature histories require complete 60/250-observation windows. Each fold computes feature imputation means and standard deviations using only complete mature Train rows. Predictions impute missing values using those fitted means.
feature_definitions.model_target: Daily centered cross-sectional percentile rank of official Train target Return, identical for Ridge and LightGBM.

model: Annual expanding-window Ridge and LightGBM regressions using identical feature transforms, target ranks, evaluation dates and EWMA smoothing.

selection_rule.primary: Descriptive Train-only comparison; no adoption or reselection because all Train periods are known.
